notes: Offline source audit completed 2026-07-25. Entries marked ready use direct assets served by the institution's official domain or its official site CDN. No asset was downloaded, uploaded, or applied to the database.

entries.reason: Confirmed AKFA University was renamed Central Asian University (CAU) effective 26 June 2023 (centralasian.uz rename announcement; Wikipedia 'Central Asian University'; THE rankings page). The legacy akfauniversity.uz domain now fails outright (DNS resolution failure), confirming there is no separate live AKFA-branded site left to source assets from. This is an unresolved rename/identity situation, not a missing-asset situation, so no image is sourced. Needs a human catalogue decision (retire, redirect, or relabel the record) rather than media.
